s1.syndrome_frame: A painful polypoid mass on the gingiva with bone resorption and atypical cells
salient_findings: 10-mm polypoid mass on the left lower gingiva
Moth-eaten pattern of mandibular bone resorption on panoramic radiography
Atypical spindle and pleomorphic cells on biopsy
key_facts: 69-year-old Japanese man
Pain and mass on the left lower gingiva
History of chemoradiotherapy for squamous cell carcinoma of the left buccal mucosa
No tobacco or alcohol use
Trismus present
Normal vital signs
Rough-surfaced polypoid lesion on intraoral inspection
Whitish pseudomembrane covering the lesion
Mandibular bone destruction on contrast-enhanced CT
Biopsy showed loose granulation tissue with atypical cells
Spindle cells had basophilic cytoplasm, bizarre nuclei, and atypical mitoses
Immunohistochemical staining positive for vimentin, α-smooth muscle actin, p63, p53, and CD68
Ki-67 labeling index approximately 50%

shortlist.label: Sarcomatoid squamous cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: History of squamous cell carcinoma and presence of atypical spindle cells

shortlist.label: Spindle cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of spindle cells with basophilic cytoplasm and atypical mitoses

shortlist.label: Malignant fibrous histiocytoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of atypical cells and positive immunohistochemical staining for vimentin and CD68

shortlist.label: Inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of spindle cells and positive immunohistochemical staining for α-smooth muscle actin

shortlist.label: Myxofibrosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of atypical cells and high Ki-67 labeling index

raw.rationale: The patient's history of squamous cell carcinoma of the left buccal mucosa and the presence of a spindle cell lesion with atypical cells and high Ki-67 labeling index, alongside the expression of p63, which is often seen in squamous cell carcinomas, supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Spindle cell carcinoma
rejected.why: While similar, spindle cell carcinoma is less likely given the specific context of the patient's history and the immunohistochemical profile.

rejected.label: Malignant fibrous histiocytoma
rejected.why: The lack of specific markers and the clinical context do not strongly support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor
rejected.why: The high Ki-67 labeling index and the presence of atypical mitoses are not typical for this tumor, which usually has a lower proliferative index.

rejected.label: Myxofibrosarcoma
rejected.why: The clinical presentation and the histological features, including the presence of a whitish pseudomembrane and the specific immunohistochemical staining pattern, do not align well with myxofibrosarcoma.
